acceptance: Admit only proved estimates and precisely scoped obstructions. Numerical homogeneous gap stays limited unless all iteration, domain and representation obligations close.

definitions.baseline_iteration: At each stage use the bare-reference homological inverse H0_Y|Q, sum local skew generators and perform their finite-volume simultaneous rotation. Retain all bounded commutator series and support multiplicities; do not assume the diagonal part commutes with new generators. Alternatives must be explicitly declared and proved, not silently substituted.
definitions.baseline_weights: mu_n=log(2)/2+log(2)/(2(n+1)); delta_n=mu_n-mu_(n+1). This schedule is a declared proof choice, not a physical deformation. A different positive-limit schedule may be compared if its full recurrence is derived.
definitions.initial: H1=H0+D0+R0 from accepted O1, ||R0||_log2<=(25460736/25)tau^2 on |tau|<=5/1664; D0=sum Q phi Q has relative coefficient28|tau| and ||D0||_log2<=448|tau|.
definitions.norm: ||Phi||_mu=sup_x sum_(Y contains x) exp(mu |Y|)||Phi_Y|| for explicit indexed finite-support decomposition. Initial mu0=log(2); preserve a positive limiting weight.
definitions.splitting: For each bounded self-adjoint local residual R_Y, set P_Y=|Omega_Y><Omega_Y|, Q=I-P, c_Y=<Omega,R_Y Omega>, A_Y=Q R_Y P+P R_Y Q, Z_Y=Q(R_Y-c_Y I)Q. Retain all scalar energies and all Z_Y in updated diagonal interaction; eliminate A_Y using the inverse of H0_Y on Q.
definitions.units: All h,D,R,S and tau here dimensionless; physical Hamiltonian is delta times the operator, clock t/hbar. Weight parameters are proof devices only.

graph_boundary: Same complete-star boundary as O1; generated supports are arbitrary finite unions, never reset to four-site stars.
model: Homogeneous I1/I2 and O1 full-link coarse-block model; fixed a,E_star,alpha/E_star,hbar; normalized energies by delta=alpha/8; no canonical q profile.
next_loop: After O2 review reassess and select P1. Q/R remain unselected until all six N/O/P reviews.
proposed_not_accepted: The accepted O1 initial remainder may allow a generated-support homological iteration with a positive numerical tau threshold and volume-uniform gap. Test this proposal; a rigorous obstruction to this stated majorant is a limited result, not gap failure.
representation: Finite cuboids with complete O1 stars, separable unbounded onsite h_x>=I-P_x; finite-volume operator domain D(H0). Volume-uniform interaction estimates do not by themselves construct an infinite global unitary.
required: Prove the arbitrary-support homological map, scalar/diagonal splitting bounds and common unbounded-domain preservation with explicit constants.
Derive an all-support commutator estimate at equal weight or with explicit weight loss; supply a discriminating growing-support control if an equal-weight universal estimate fails.

Derive a complete one-step remainder majorant, inverse-gap assumptions, relative diagonal update and repeated-step numerical recurrence including retained D0. Do not infer contraction from a single small residual.

Evaluate an explicit tau example or positive threshold if possible. Test convergence, cumulative weight loss, scalar energy bookkeeping and whether the premises actually certify a gap through every step.

If a chosen majorant cannot certify iteration, identify the exact failed inequality and quantify it. Distinguish certificate failure, actual algorithm failure, actual homogeneous gap failure and continuum claims.
Review the precise applicable primary proof step when used; no guessed constants or finite-dimensional theorem transfer. Prior checked source maps may be cited at their actual reading depth.
Use independent exact controls, normal/optimized fresh output, source closure including every declared instruction input, and no duplicate replay trees.
target: Test whether arbitrary generated-support homological elimination closes an explicit numerical stability iteration, allowing quantified exponential support-weight loss and retaining the first-order diagonal interaction.
